rationale: The plan correctly uses DESeq2/edgeR with ~subject+condition, explicitly blocks on subject, states residual df, and forbids an unpaired model as primary; per-subject 'response' is honestly reframed as direction-consistency across 5 pairs since no per-subject p-value exists. QC (PCA/correlation by subject and condition, library size, outlier policy with explicit consequence statement) precedes testing, filterByExpr is used with justification tied to the paired design, and normalization (median-of-ratios/TMM) is internal to the model with raw counts enforced throughout. BH FDR at both 0.05/0.10 plus apeglm/ashr shrinkage with unshrunken SE reported separately is well handled, and enrichment specifies ranking metric, universe, collection, size window, and redundancy handling, losing minor points only for contingency fallback wording. Report completeness is strong: versions of methods, formulas, thresholds, gene counts, and design caveats are all explicitly required outputs.
